blocks.task_summary: Find the length of major arc ACB given the area of triangle AOB is 26 cm² and angle AOB = 2.51 radians.
method_path: Use area of triangle formula (1/2)r² sinθ = 26 to find radius r
Calculate major arc length using r(2π - θ)

evidence.basis: Attempts to use the area formula for triangle AOB AND equate it to 26 (M1); 1/2 r^2 sin(2.51) = 26 (A1); r = 9.38462... (A1); use of arc length formula to find the major arc ACB (M1); 9.38462... (2π - 2.51) OR 2π × 9.38462... - 9.38462... × 2.51 OR 9.38462... × 3.773185...; 35.4099…; (arc length =) 35.4 (cm) A1
